review.comment: Inclusive sum with for (n <= end) and start/end swap covers 1/5, 5/1, and 3/3 correctly. Invalid input prints ERROR: invalid range but does not stop, so Sum still prints after. Next: return right after the error log (and rl.close) so only the ERROR line is output.

All acceptance criteria pass: inclusive for-loop with n <= end, swap when start > end, and Sum format matches. Invalid non-integers print ERROR: invalid range and return so no Sum line follows. Solid use of for-loop bounds and accumulator init.
